items.name: Premierball

items.name: DNA Splicer
description: While in the presence of a willing Reshiram or Zekrom, Kyurem can fuse with one of the willing Pokemon, at will, with the help of a DNA Splicer. This process is called Absofusion and will result in a White Kyurem (if fused with Reshiram) or Black Kyurem (if fused with Zekrom).

items.name: Abyssplatte
description: When held by a Clamperl, its AC is increased by 1.

items.name: Abysszahn
description: When held by a Clamperl, its STAB is increased by 1.

items.name: Gracidea Flower
description: When held by a Shaymin, the Shaymin may use its action to change between its Land and Sky forms.

items.name: Platinum-Orb
description: When held by a Giratina, the Giratina may use its action to change between its Altered and Origin forms. Its Dragon- and Ghost-type moves have double STAB.

items.name: Leek
description: When held by a Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd, the holder's critical hit range increases by two.
Most of the time, this means attacks can critical on a natural 18, 19, or 20. For a move like Slash which already expands critical hit range, criticals can happen on natural 17, 18, 19, or 20.

items.name: Kugelblitz
description: When held by a Pikachu, raises its MOVE power modifier by +1.

items.name: Lucky Punch
description: When held by a Chansey, its critical hit range increases by one.
Most of the time, this means attacks can critical on a natural 19 or 20. For a move like Slash which already expands critical hit range, criticals can happen on natural 18, 19, or 20.

items.name: Metallstaub
description: When held by a Ditto, its CON score increases by +3.

items.name: N-Solarizer
description: A trainer with both a Solgaleo and Necrozma may use an action to fuse them into a Dusk Mane Necrozma. The trainer may also use an action to separate a Dusk Mane Necrozma into a Solgaleo and Necrozma.

items.name: N-Lunarizer
description: A trainer with both a Lunala and Necrozma may use an action to fuse them into a Dawn Wings Necrozma. The trainer may also use an action to separate a Dawn Wings Necrozma into a Lunala and Necrozma.

items.name: Banngefäß
description: A trainer may use their action to unconfine a nearby Hoopa, changing it from its Confined form to Unconfimed form for three days.

items.name: Wahrspiegel
description: When held by a Thundurus, Landorus, Tornadus, or Enamorus, the holder may use its action to change between its Incarnate and Therian forms.

items.name: Kampfknochen
description: When held by a Cubone, Marowak, or Alolan Marowak, the holder's STAB is doubled.

items.name: Blitzmodul

description: Wild Gimmighoul (Roaming) Pokémon carry 1d4 Gimmighoul Coins. Wild Gimmighoul (Chest) Pokèmon carry 1d20 + 10 Gimmighoul Coins.

items.name: Trainer's License
description: Only licensed trainers are permitted to capture Pokémon, and this license identifies you as having such authorization. It also allows trainers to gain access to special services at Pokémon centers and to purchase goods at the Poké Mart.
Trainers can lose their license for attacking other trainers or their Pokémon, or failing to take care of their own Pokémon.

items.name: Pokédex
description: A hand-held computer with an advanced camera and image recognition software. A trainer can use a bonus action to identify a Pokémon within 60 feet using the Pokédex's scanner. Doing so registers the Pokémon on the Pokedex, and reveals the base SR and some brief facts about the species.

items.name: Angel
description: Allows you to fish for Pokémon. Fishing for Pokémon takes one hour, and the Pokémon you catch is random.
The Old Rod allows you to catch only Magikarp.

items.name: Profiangel
description: Allows you to fish for Pokémon. Fishing for Pokémon takes one hour, and the Pokémon you catch is random.

The Good Rod allows you to catch Alomomola, Azumarill, Barboach, Basculin, Bibarel, Briionne, Bruxish, Buizel, Carvanha, Chinchou, Clamperl, Clauncher, Corphish, Corsola, Crawdaunt, Croconaw, Dewpider, Dewott, Ducklett, Feebas, Finneon, Frillish, Froakie, Frogadier, Goldeen, Horsea, Inkay, Kabuto, Krabby, Lanturn, Lombre, Lotad, Luvdisc, Magikarp, Mantyke, Mareanie, Marill, Marshtomp, Mudkip, Octillery, Omanyte, Oshawott, Palpitoad, Piplup, Poliwag, Poliwhirl, Popplio, Prinplup, Psyduck, Pyukumuku, Quagsire, Qwilfish, Remoraid, Seel, Shellder, Shellos, Skrelp, Slowpoke, Spheal, Squirtle, Staryu, Stunfisk, Surskit, Tentacool, Tirtouga, Totodile, Tympole, Tynamo, Wailmer, Wartortle, Whiscash, Wimpod, Wingull, Wishiwashi, or Wooper.

items.name: Superangel
description: Allows you to fish for Pokémon. Fishing for Pokémon takes one hour, and the Pokémon you catch is random.

The Super Rod allows you to catch Araquanid, Blastoise, Carracosta, Clawitzer, Cloyster, Dewgong, Dragalge, Empoleon, Feraligatr, Floatzel, Gastrodon, Golduck, Golisopod, Gorebyss, Greninja, Gyarados, Huntail, Jellicent, Kabutops, Kingdra, Kingler, Lapras, Ludicolo, Lumineon, Malamar, Mantine, Milotic, Omastar, Politoed, Poliwrath, Primarina, Relicanth, Samurott, Seadra, Seaking, Sealeo, Seismitoad, Sharpedo, Slowbro, Slowking, Starmie, Swampert, Tentacruel, Toxapex, Wailord, Walrein.

items.name: Fluchtseil
description: Consume in order to automatically succeed in fleeing from a wild Pokémon battle.

items.name: Honig
description: Can be used to automatically attract a single Pokémon that resides in the area. Which Pokémon is up to the DM's discretion.

items.name: Schlüssel-Stein
description: Allows a trainer to Mega Evolve their Pokémon. Has one charge, and recovers its charge at dawn each day.

items.name: Z-Ring
description: Allows a trainer to unleash their Pokémon's Z-Power in the form of a Z-Move. Has one charge, and recovers its charge at dawn each day.

items.name: Dynamax-Band
description: Allows a trainer to Dynamax their Pokémon. Has one charge, and recovers its charge at dawn each day.

items.name: Tera Orb
description: Allows a trainer to Terastallize their Pokémon. Has one charge, and recovers its charge at dawn each day.

items.name: Capture Styler
description: Allows a Pokémon Ranger to add +10 to their capture rolls against Pokémon they have fully encircled using their movement.
Only useable by trainers who take the Ranger trainer path.

items.name: Backpack
description: A backpack that can hold up to 30 pounds.

items.name: Binoculars
description: You can see objects up to double their size.

items.name: Camping Kettle
description: A kettle that can be placed in or above a campfire for heating up liquids.

items.name: Camping Stove
description: A light, portable stove that is heated by wood chips.

items.name: Canteen
description: A metal or plastic canteen to carry water or other liquids.

items.name: Energy Cell
description: A small, flat disc, used to provide energy for various powered objects.

items.name: Flashlight
description: Casts bright light in a 15-foot cone and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Requires a new energy cell after 4 hours of use.

items.name: Solar Flashlight
description: Casts bright light in a 15-foot cone and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Charges in the sunlight; for each hour doing so, it gains an hour of use, up to 4 hours.

items.name: Flint and Steel
description: A 'D'-shaped piece of steel and a square of flint to make a spark to start a fire.

items.name: Climber's Kit
description: Includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. You have advantage on climbing checks and you can't fall more than 25 ft if you fail. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Cooking Kit
description: Includes pots, pans, utensils, and molds for cooking. Used to make foods while in a kitchen or similar facility. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Diver's Kit
description: Includes a wetsuit, diving belt, mask, fins, and air tanks. While worn it reduces your movement speed by 20ft, but gives you a swimming speed of 30ft. In addition, you have 2 hours of air, can dive a depth of 200ft, and aren't affected by the water's temperature.

items.name: Gardener's Kit
description: Includes clippers, gloves, a spade, and a watering pale. It's everything needed to gather and care for plants, berries, and apricorn trees. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Lantern
description: Casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an aditional 30 feet. Requires a new energy cell after 4 hours of use.

items.name: Solar Lantern
description: Casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an aditional 30 feet. Needs to recharge in the sunlight for a short rest, but otherwise provides 4 hours of light.

items.name: Mess Kit
description: This stainless steel box contains a cup and simple cutlery. The box clamps together, and one side can be used as a cooking pan, and the other as a plate or shallow bowl.

items.name: Multi-tool
description: A tool with pliers, scissors, knife, and other basic tools. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Pocket Knife
description: A small pocket knife with micro tools. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Camping Ration
description: An air-tight packet of freeze-dried food. Add hot water to reconstitute. Provides a daily meal for one person.

items.name: Rebreather
description: A small breathing apparatus that allows breathing underwater. Its filter needs to be replaced after 4 hours of use.

items.name: Rebreather Filter
description: A filter for a rebreather.

items.name: Sleeping Bag
description: A sleeping bag for one person.

items.name: Solar Charger
description: A solar charger stores sunlight during a short rest during the day, and can be used to charge two energy cells during a long rest.

items.name: Small Tent
description: A tent for two people.

items.name: Large Tent
description: A tent for four people.

items.name: Artisan Tools
description: Tools used by tradesmen, such as calligraphers, artists, or smiths. Choose one type of artisan tool upon purchase. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
description: You can add your proficiency modifier to checks when disarming traps or opening locks.

items.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
description: Contains a backpack, climber's kit, flashlight, 5 energy cells, flint and steel, 10 camping rations, a canteen, and 30 feet of rope.

items.name: Explorer's Pack
description: Contains a backpack, sleeping bag, mess kit, flint and steel, flashlight, 5 energy cells, 10 camping rations, a canteen, and 30 feet of rope.

items.name: Filcher's Pack
description: Contains a bacpack, thieves' tools, 20 feet of wire,a bell, a lantern, 3 energy cells, 5 camping rations, flint and steel, and a canteen.

items.name: Egg Incubator
description: When an Egg is placed inside, it reduces the Hatch Time by 1d20 each day. Once the egg hatches, the incubator loses its effectiveness.

items.name: Egg Incubator Plus
description: When an Egg is placed inside, it reduces the Hatch Time by 2d20 each day. Once the egg hatches, the incubator loses its effectiveness.

items.name: Egg Incubator Super
description: When an Egg is placed inside, it reduces the Hatch Time by 3d20 each day. Once the egg hatches, the incubator loses its effectiveness.
